232:   buildGates() {
233:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
234:       color: 0x9fb2c4, transparent: true, opacity: 0.35, depthWrite: false,
235:       side: THREE.DoubleSide,
236:     });
237:     for (const g of this.world.gates) {
238:       const h = g.size.h || 8;
239:       const w = g.size.w || 8;
240:       const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h);
241:       const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat.clone());
242:       if (g.flat) {
243:         mesh.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
244:         mesh.position.set(g.pos.x, 0.6, g.pos.z);
245:       } else {
246:         mesh.rotation.y = (g.rot || 0);
247:         mesh.position.set(g.pos.x, h / 2 - 0.4, g.pos.z);
248:       }
249:       g.mesh = mesh;
250:       this.scene.add(mesh);
251:       const locked = this.gateLocked(g);
252:       g.locked = locked;
253:       if (locked) {
254:         const b = this.gateBox(g);
255:         b._gateId = g.id;
256:         this.gateColliders.push(b);
257:       }
258:       this.gates.push(g);
259:     }
260:     this.checkGatesAuto(false);
261:   }
262: 
263:   gateBox(g) {
264:     const h = g.size.h || 8;
265:     const w = g.size.w || 8;
266:     if (g.flat) {
267:       return {
268:         minX: g.pos.x - 0.6, maxX: g.pos.x + 0.6,
269:         minY: 0, maxY: 1.4, minZ: g.pos.z - w / 2, maxZ: g.pos.z + w / 2,
270:       };
271:     }
272:     return {
273:       minX: g.pos.x - w / 2, maxX: g.pos.x + w / 2,
274:       minY: -2, maxY: h + 1, minZ: g.pos.z - 0.5, maxZ: g.pos.z + 0.5,
275:     };
276:   }
277: 
278:   gateLocked(g) {
279:     const need = g.needs;
280:     if (Array.isArray(need)) {
281:       return need.some((k) => !this.player.inventory.has(k));
282:     }
283:     if (need in ABILITY_KEYS) {
284:       return !this.player.abilities[need];
285:     }
286:     return !this.player.inventory.has(need);
287:   }
288: 
289:   checkGatesAuto(quiet = true) {
290:     for (const g of this.gates) {
291:       const locked = this.gateLocked(g);
292:       if (!locked && g.locked) {
293:         g.locked = false;
294:         this.gateColliders = this.gateColliders.filter((c) => c._gateId !== g.id);
295:         if (g.mesh) {
296:           this.effects.bursts.emit(g.mesh.position.clone(), { count: 26, color: { r: 0.8, g: 0.9, b: 1 }, speed: 3.4, spread: 2.2, lift: 2, gravity: 1, size: 0.5 });
297:           g.mesh.visible = false;
298:         }
299:         this.audio.sfx('unlock');
300:         this.hud.toast(`«${g.label}» — путь открыт`);
301:       } else if (locked && !g.locked) {
302:         g.locked = true;
303:         const b = this.gateBox(g);
304:         b._gateId = g.id;
305:         this.gateColliders.push(b);
306:         g.mesh.visible = true;
307:       }
308:     }
309:   }

398:   // стабильная «биометрия» персонажа: одно и то же при каждом запуске
399:   npcBodySpec(n) {
400:     if (n.body) return n.body;
401:     let h = 2166136261;
402:     const key = String(n.id || n.name || 'npc');
403:     for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
404:       h ^= key.charCodeAt(i);
405:       h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
406:     }
407:     const r = (salt) => {
408:       h ^= salt + 0x9e3779b9;
409:       h = Math.imul(h, 16777619);
410:       return ((h >>> 0) % 1000) / 1000;
411:     };
412:     const height = 0.88 + r(1) * 0.28;
413:     const build = 0.84 + r(2) * 0.34;
414:     const head = 1.0 + (1.02 - height) * 0.5 + (r(3) - 0.5) * 0.1;
415:     return { height, build, head };
416:   }

714:   buildEnemies() {
715:     this.wisps = [];
716:     for (const zone of Object.keys(ENCOUNTERS)) {
717:       const econf = ENCOUNTERS[zone];
718:       const count = econf.count;
719:       for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
720:         const sp = econf.spawn[i % econf.spawn.length];
721:         const w = {
722:           enemyId: econf.enemy, zone, x: sp[0], z: sp[1],
723:           baseX: sp[0], baseZ: sp[1], aggro: false, dead: false,
724:         };
725:         // wisp nest: spiked core + orbiting motes + aura shell
726:         const g = new THREE.Group();
727:         const coreMat = makePainterlyMaterial(0x4a2a2a, { emission: 0x7a3030, emissionBias: 0.85, rimStrength: 0.5 });
728:         const core = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.38, 1), coreMat);
729:         addInkOutline(core, { thickness: 0.02, opacity: 0.75 });
730:         g.add(core);
731:         const shellMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x9a3a3a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.18, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
732:         const shell = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.8, 16, 12), shellMat);
733:         shell.position.y = 0.3;
734:         g.add(shell);
735:         const motes = [];
736:         for (let m = 0; m < 3; m++) {
737:           const moteMat = makePainterlyMaterial(0xcf6a6a, { emission: 0xcf4444, emissionBias: 1.1 });
738:           const mote = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.07, 8, 8), moteMat);
739:           g.add(mote);
740:           motes.push({ mesh: mote, phase: (m / 3) * Math.PI * 2 });
741:         }
742:         g.position.set(w.x, 1.6, w.z);
743:         this.scene.add(g);
744:         w.mesh = g;
745:         w.core = core;
746:         w.shell = shell;
747:         w.motes = motes;
748:         this.wisps.push(w);
749:       }
750:     }
751:     this.bossSpawned = false;
752:     this.bossDefeated = false;
753:   }

945:       if (d.persona && PERSONAS.some((p) => p.id === d.persona)) {

947:         this.player.applyBody(this.persona.body);

953:         this.state.maxHp = d.state.maxHp;

958:       this.player.abilities.dash = !!ab.dash;
959:       this.player.abilities.jump = !!ab.jump;
960:       this.player.abilities.wall = !!ab.wall;
961:       this.player.abilities.lens = !!ab.lens;
962:       const opened = new Set(d.opened || []);
963:       for (const c of this.world.chests) c.opened = opened.has(c.id);
964:       const taken = new Set(d.taken || []);
965:       for (const it of this.world.items) {
966:         const key = it.key || it.id;

971:           it.ring.visible = false;
972:           it.glint.visible = false;
973:         }

976:       for (const w of this.wisps) {
977:         const key = w.zone + '#' + w.baseX + ',' + w.baseZ;
978:         if (dead.has(key)) { w.dead = true; if (w.mesh) w.mesh.visible = false; }

1607:   // ---------- per-frame update ----------
1608:   loop() {
1609:     requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);
1610:     const now = performance.now();
1611:     const raw = this.lastFrameTime ? (now - this.lastFrameTime) / 1000 : 0.05;
1612:     this.lastFrameTime = now;
1613:     // fixed-step accumulator: world runs at real speed even at low fps
1614:     this.stepAcc = (this.stepAcc || 0) + Math.min(raw, 0.25);
1615:     let steps = 0;
1616:     while (this.stepAcc >= 0.05 && steps < 8) {
1617:       this.stepAcc -= 0.05;
1618:       this.clock.elapsedTime += 0.05;
1619:       this.update(0.05);
1620:       steps++;
1621:     }
1622:     this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
1623:     this.minimap.render();
1624:   }

1626:   update(dt) {
1627:     const t = this.clock.elapsedTime;
1628:     // суточный цикл
1629:     const timeScale = this.getTimeScale();
1630:     if (this.mode !== 'pause') {
1631:       if (this.timeMode === 'pause') this.timeCycle.updateWeather(dt);
1632:       else if (timeScale > 0) this.timeCycle.update(dt * timeScale);
1633:     }
1634:     const dayFactor = this.timeCycle.dayFactorF || 0;
1635:     const rawWeather = this.timeCycle.weather;
1636:     const shelter = this.getShelterAt();
1637:     const sheltered = !!shelter;
1638:     const indoor = this.isIndoor();
1639:     const weather = { ...rawWeather, sheltered, indoor, shelter };
1640:     const visualWeather = {
1641:       ...weather,
1642:       rain: indoor ? 0 : weather.rain,
1643:       fog: weather.fog * (indoor ? 0.15 : 1),
1644:     };
1645:     this.weatherContext = weather;
1646:     this.player.setWeather(weather.rain, weather.windX, weather.windZ, sheltered);
1647:     if (this.player.grounded || Math.abs(this.player.pos.y - this.rainGroundY) > 12) this.rainGroundY = this.player.pos.y;
1648:     else this.rainGroundY += (this.player.pos.y - this.rainGroundY) * Math.min(1, dt * 0.45);
1649:     this.sky.update(t, dayFactor, visualWeather);
1650:     this.applyDayNight(dayFactor, visualWeather);
1651:     this.world.updateFog(t, dayFactor, visualWeather.fog);
1652:     this.effects.setWeather(visualWeather, this.rainGroundY);
1653:     this.effects.update(dt, t, this.camera.position);
1654:     this.glow.update(t, dayFactor);
1655:     this.hud.setClock(
1656:       this.timeCycle.hour, this.timeCycle.minute, this.timeCycle.second, dayFactor
1657:     );
1658:     this.hud.setWeather(weather.state);
1659:     this.holo.update(t, dt);
1660: 
1661:     if (this.mode === 'ending') {
1662:       this.driftCamera(dt);
1663:       return;
1664:     }
1665: 
1666:     if (this.mode === 'intro') {
1667:       this.cinematic.update(dt);
1668:       this.animateProps(dt);
1669:       return;
1670:     }
1671: 
1672:     const input = this.input.consume();
1673: 
1674:     if (this.mode === 'explore') {
1675:       if (input.pause) { this.togglePause(); }
1676:       if (input.map) { this.toggleMap(); }
1677:       if (input.lens) {
1678:         this.lensActive = !this.lensActive;
1679:         this.hud.toast(this.lensActive ? 'Зрение личины: следы светятся' : 'Зрение личины выключено');
1680:         this.world.items.forEach((it) => { if (!it.taken) it.halo.material.opacity = this.lensActive ? 0.95 : 0.65; });
1681:       }
1682:       if (input.interact) this.tryInteract();
1683:       if (input.inventory) this.toggleInventory();
1684: 
1685:       if (this.mount && input.jumpSpace) this.dismount(true);
1686: 
1687:       if (this.mount) {
1688:         this.updateMount(dt, t);
1689:       } else {
1690:         this.player.update(dt * 1.0, this.input, this.cameraYaw, this.setupGateSolids());
1691:       }
1692:       this.updateCamera(dt, input);
1693:       this.minimap.update(dt);
1694:       this.updateInteractions();
1695:       this.checkZones();
1696:       this.checkTransitions();
1697:       this.player.mesh.visible = true;
1698: 
1699:       // enemy wisps
1700:       this.updateWisps(dt);
1701:       this.updateCrowd(dt, t);
1702: 
1703:       // boss trigger
1704:       this.checkBossTrigger();
1705:     } else if (this.mode === 'dialogue') {
1706:       this.input.consume();
1707:     } else if (this.mode === 'map') {
1708:       if (input.map || input.pause) this.toggleMap();
1709:     } else if (this.mode === 'inventory') {
1710:       if (input.map || input.pause || input.inventory) this.toggleInventory();
1711:       this.input.consume();
1712:     } else if (this.mode === 'pause') {
1713:       if (input.pause) { this.resumeFromPause(); }
1714:       this.input.consume();
1715:     } else if (this.mode === 'combat') {
1716:       this.driftCamera(dt);
1717:     }
1718:     this.animateProps(dt);
1719:     this.updateAmbience(dt);
1720:     this.tutorial.update();

1724:   updateAmbience(dt) {
1725:     const p = this.player.pos;
1726:     const zone = (x, z, r) => {
1727:       const dx = (p.x - x) / r;
1728:       const dz = (p.z - z) / r;
1729:       return Math.exp(-(dx * dx + dz * dz));
1730:     };
1731:     this.audio.setZone('bar', zone(32, 3, 26));
1732:     this.audio.setZone('plaza', zone(64, -33, 30));
1733:     this.audio.setZone('harbor', zone(196, 122, 44));
1734:     this.audio.setZone('drain', zone(132, 12, 24));
1735:     const weatherWind = this.weatherContext ? this.weatherContext.wind * (this.weatherContext.sheltered ? 0.25 : 1) : 0;
1736:     this.audio.setWind(Math.max(weatherWind, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.y / 26 + zone(84, 4, 40) * 0.5))));

1744:   updateCamera(dt, input) {
1745:     const p = this.player;
1746:     const joyX = this.input.camJoyX;
1747:     const joyY = this.input.camJoyY;
1748:     const keyCam = this.input.camHeld;
1749:     if (Math.abs(joyX) > 0.08 || Math.abs(joyY) > 0.08 || keyCam !== 0 || input.camMode || input.camModeSet) this.player.breakIdleActivity();
1750: 
1751:     // camera mode: V cycles, 1/2/3 and HUD buttons pick a specific view
1752:     if (input.camModeSet) {
1753:       this.setCameraMode(input.camModeSet);
1754:       if (this.tutorial) this.tutorial.marksSwitches.camera = true;
1755:     }
1756:     if (input.camMode) {
1757:       const modes = ['orbit', 'fps', 'top'];
1758:       const idx = modes.indexOf(this.cameraMode);
1759:       this.setCameraMode(modes[(idx + 1) % modes.length]);
1760:       if (this.tutorial) this.tutorial.marksSwitches.camera = true;
1761:     }
1762: 
1763:     if (this.cameraMode === 'fps') {
1764:       const yawRate = -(keyCam * 2.7 + joyX * 2.7) * (this.cameraInverted ? -1 : 1);
1765:       if (yawRate !== 0) this.cameraYaw += yawRate * dt;
1766:       if (joyY !== 0) {
1767:         this.cameraPitch = Math.max(-1.2, Math.min(1.2, this.cameraPitch + joyY * 1.4 * dt));
1768:       }
1769:       p.mesh.rotation.y = this.cameraYaw;
1770:       const headY = p.pos.y + p.headHeight;
1771:       this.camera.position.set(p.pos.x, headY, p.pos.z);
1772:       const dir = new THREE.Vector3(
1773:         Math.sin(this.cameraYaw) * Math.cos(this.cameraPitch),
1774:         Math.sin(this.cameraPitch),
1775:         Math.cos(this.cameraYaw) * Math.cos(this.cameraPitch)
1776:       );
1777:       this.camera.lookAt(p.pos.x + dir.x, headY + dir.y, p.pos.z + dir.z);
1778:       return;
1779:     }
1780: 
1781:     if (this.cameraMode === 'top') {
1782:       const dist = 28;
1783:       const targetX = p.pos.x;
1784:       const targetZ = p.pos.z;
1785:       const targetY = p.pos.y + dist;
1786:       this.camera.position.x += (targetX - this.camera.position.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
1787:       this.camera.position.y += (targetY - this.camera.position.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
1788:       this.camera.position.z += (targetZ - this.camera.position.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
1789:       this.camera.lookAt(p.pos.x, p.pos.y, p.pos.z);
1790:       return;
1791:     }
1792: 
1793:     // ORBIT (default)
1794:     const yawRate = -(keyCam * 2.7 + joyX * 2.7) * (this.cameraInverted ? -1 : 1);
1795:     if (yawRate !== 0) this.cameraYaw += yawRate * dt;
1796: 
1797:     if (joyY !== 0) {
1798:       this.cameraPitch = Math.max(-0.6, Math.min(0.9, this.cameraPitch + joyY * 1.4 * dt));
1799:     }
1800: 
1801:     const aspect = this.camera.aspect;
1802:     const portrait = aspect < 1;
1803:     const dist = portrait ? 13 : 9;
1804:     const hy = portrait ? 4.6 : 3.1;
1805:     const ax = Math.sin(this.cameraYaw) * dist;
1806:     const az = Math.cos(this.cameraYaw) * dist;
1807:     const targetX = p.pos.x - ax;
1808:     const targetZ = p.pos.z - az;
1809:     const targetY = p.pos.y + hy + Math.sin(this.cameraPitch) * dist * 0.35;
1810:     this.camera.position.x += (targetX - this.camera.position.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 7);
1811:     this.camera.position.y += (targetY - this.camera.position.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 7);
1812:     this.camera.position.z += (targetZ - this.camera.position.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 7);
1813:     this.camera.lookAt(p.pos.x, p.pos.y + 1.4, p.pos.z);
1814:   }

1898:   playerAttack(pos, dir) {
1899:     const range = 1.9;
1900:     const ang = 1.2;
1901:     if (this.world.peds) {
1902:       for (const ped of this.world.peds) {
1903:         if (ped.activity !== null || !ped.fig || !ped.fig.g) continue;
1904:         const fx = ped.fig.g.position.x, fz = ped.fig.g.position.z;
1905:         const dx = fx - pos.x, dz = fz - pos.z;
1906:         if (Math.hypot(dx, dz) > range) continue;
1907:         if (dir && Math.hypot(dx, dz) > 0.001) {
1908:           const dot = (dx * dir.x + dz * dir.z) / Math.hypot(dx, dz);
1909:           if (dot < -ang) continue;
1910:         }
1911:         ped.fig.g.position.x += dx * 0.45;
1912:         ped.fig.g.position.z += dz * 0.45;
1913:         ped._bump = 0.5;
1914:         this.audio.sfx('hit');
1915:       }
1916:     }
1917:     for (const w of this.wisps) {
1918:       if (w.dead) continue;
1919:       const dx = w.x - pos.x, dz = w.z - pos.z;
1920:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dz) > range + 0.4) continue;
1921:       w.x += dx * 0.8;
1922:       w.z += dz * 0.8;
1923:       w.mesh.position.x = w.x;
1924:       w.mesh.position.z = w.z;
1925:       this.effects.wispHit(new THREE.Vector3(w.x, 1.6, w.z));
1926:       this.audio.sfx('hit');
1927:     }

123:     this.stop();

132:   // текущая реплика договорена до конца (или её движок сменился):
133:   // если в очереди есть следующая — озвучиваем её, реплики не обрываются
134:   _finishLine() {
135:     this.speaking = false;
136:     if (this._queue.length) {
137:       const next = this._queue.shift();
138:       if (next) this._dispatch(next.line, next.profile || {});
139:     }

142:   stop() {
143:     try { if (this.synth) this.synth.cancel(); } catch (e) {}
144:     if (this._source) { try { this._source.stop(); } catch (e) {} this._source = null; }
145:     if (this._audioEl) { try { this._audioEl.pause(); } catch (e) {} this._audioEl = null; }
146:     if (this._gTimer) { clearTimeout(this._gTimer); this._gTimer = null; }
147:     const bridge = this.androidTTS;
148:     if (bridge && typeof bridge.stop === 'function') { try { bridge.stop(); } catch (e) {} }
149:     this._cleanupEdge();
150:     this._killSynth();
151:     this._queue = [];
152:     this.speaking = false;

155:   // режет текст на куски <= limit, не разрывая слова
156:   _chunkText(text, limit) {
157:     const clean = String(text).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
158:     if (!clean) return [];
159:     if (clean.length <= limit) return [clean];
160:     const parts = [];
161:     let cur = '';
162:     for (const word of clean.split(' ')) {
163:       if (!cur) { cur = word; continue; }
164:       if ((cur + ' ' + word).length <= limit) {
165:         cur += ' ' + word;
166:       } else {
167:         parts.push(cur);
168:         cur = word;
169:         while (cur.length > limit) {
170:           parts.push(cur.slice(0, limit));
171:           cur = cur.slice(limit);
172:         }
173:       }
174:     }
175:     if (cur) parts.push(cur);
176:     return parts.filter(Boolean);
177:   }

179:   speak(line, profile = {}, opts = {}) {
180:     if (!this.enabled || !line) return;
181:     profile = profile || {};
182:     // очередь: следующие реплики не обрывают текущую, а ждут её окончания
183:     // (диалоги читаются по порядку, как в настоящем разговоре)
184:     if (opts.queue && this.speaking) {
185:       this._queue.push({ line, profile });
186:       return;
187:     }
188:     this.stop();
189:     this._dispatch(line, profile);
190:   }

192:   _dispatch(line, profile = {}) {
193:     const mode = this.mode;
194:     if (mode === 'synth') { this._speakSynth(line, profile); return; }
195:     if (mode === 'google') {
196:       this._speakGoogle(line, profile, (ok) => { if (!ok) this._speakWebThenSynth(line, profile); });
197:       return;
198:     }
199:     if (mode === 'web') { this._speakWebThenSynth(line, profile); return; }
200:     if (mode === 'edge') {
201:       this._speakEdge(line, profile, (ok) => { if (!ok) this._speakGoogle(line, profile, (ok2) => { if (!ok2) this._speakSynth(line, profile); }); });
202:       return;
203:     }
204:     // auto: Edge → Google → системный голос → локальный синтезатор
205:     if (this.supportedEdge) {
206:       this._speakEdge(line, profile, (ok) => {
207:         if (ok) return;
208:         this._speakGoogle(line, profile, (ok2) => { if (!ok2) this._speakWebThenSynth(line, profile); });
209:       });
210:       return;
211:     }
212:     this._speakGoogle(line, profile, (ok) => { if (!ok) this._speakWebThenSynth(line, profile); });
213:   }

215:   // --- 2. Google Translate TTS ---
216:   // Три пути, по очереди:
217:   //   1) релей (если задан) — mp3 с CORS, читаем байты и играем через WebAudio;
218:   //   2) прямой mp3 через <audio> — CORS не нужен, но звучит системный плеер;
219:   //   3) JSON-эндпоинт clients5 с base64 (если он ещё отдаёт аудио).
220:   _speakGoogle(line, profile, cb) {
221:     const chunks = this._chunkText(line, GTTS_CHUNK);
222:     if (!chunks.length) { cb(false); return; }
223:     let i = 0;
224:     const playNext = () => {
225:       if (i >= chunks.length) { this._finishLine(); cb(true); return; }
226:       const text = chunks[i++];
227:       this._googleChunk(text, profile, (ok) => {
228:         if (!ok) { this.speaking = false; cb(false); return; }
229:         setTimeout(playNext, 60);
230:       });
231:     };
232:     this.speaking = true;
233:     playNext();
234:   }

236:   // токен gTTS: без него endpoint иногда отдаёт HTML-ошибку вместо mp3
237:   _gttsToken(text) {
238:     const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(text);
239:     let buf = 0;
240:     let len = 0;
241:     for (const c of bytes) {
242:       buf = c;
243:       len += buf * (len + 1);
244:       if (len >= 0x8000) {
245:         len = 0;
246:         len += (buf ^ 0xff) << 24 >> 2;
247:       }
248:       while (len & 0xffff0000) len = (len & 0x7fffffff) >> 1;
249:     }
250:     return len >>> 0;
251:   }
252: 
253:   _googleChunk(text, profile, cb) {
254:     const rate = this._clamp(profile.rate !== undefined ? profile.rate : 1, 0.5, 2);
255:     const tl = profile.tl || 'ru';
256:     // Google принимает ttspeed только в диапазоне 0.24…0.99
257:     const speed = Math.max(0.24, Math.min(0.99, rate * 0.45 + 0.32)).toFixed(2);
258:     const tk = this._gttsToken(text);
259:     const direct = `${GTTS_URL}${encodeURIComponent(text)}&ttspeed=${speed}&tk=${tk}&total=1&idx=0&textlen=${text.length}`;
260: 
261:     if (this._edgeRelay) {
262:       // 1) релей: CORS открыт, байты читаем и играем через общий WebAudio
263:       const base = String(this._edgeRelay).replace(/\/+$/, '');
264:       fetch(base + '/google?text=' + encodeURIComponent(text) + '&tl=' + encodeURIComponent(tl), { mode: 'cors' })
265:         .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.arrayBuffer() : Promise.reject(new Error('relay ' + r.status))))
266:         .then((buf) => this._playBuf(buf, cb, 'google'))
267:         .catch(() => this._googleDirect(text, direct, cb));
268:       return;
269:     }
270:     this._googleDirect(text, direct, cb);
271:   }
272: 
273:   _googleDirect(text, url, cb) {
274:     let settled = false;
275:     const finish = (ok) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; this._audioEl = null; if (this._gTimer) { clearTimeout(this._gTimer); this._gTimer = null; } cb(ok); };
276:     const tryJson = () => {
277:       if (settled) return;
278:       if (typeof fetch !== 'function') { finish(false); return; }
279:       fetch(CLIENTS5_URL + encodeURIComponent(text), { mode: 'cors', credentials: 'omit' })
280:         .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.text() : Promise.reject(new Error('http ' + r.status))))
281:         .then((txt) => {
282:           const json = JSON.parse(txt);
283:           const b64 = json && json[1] && typeof json[1] === 'string' ? json[1] : '';
284:           if (!b64) throw new Error('no audio');
285:           const bin = atob(b64);
286:           const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
287:           for (let k = 0; k < bin.length; k++) bytes[k] = bin.charCodeAt(k);
288:           this._playBuf(bytes.buffer, finish, 'google');
289:         })
290:         .catch(() => finish(false));
291:     };
292:     try {
293:       const a = new Audio(url);
294:       this._audioEl = a;
295:       this._markSource('google');
296:       a.volume = this.audio.muted ? 0 : 1;
297:       a.onended = () => finish(true);
298:       a.onerror = () => tryJson();
299:       const p = a.play();
300:       if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') p.catch(() => tryJson());
301:       this._gTimer = setTimeout(() => tryJson(), 2500);
302:     } catch (e) {
303:       tryJson();
304:     }
305:   }

307:   // --- 1. Edge TTS cloud ---
308:   _speakEdge(line, profile, cb) {
309:     if (!this.supportedEdge) { cb(false); return; }
310:     if (this._edgeRelay) { this._relaySpeech(line, profile, cb); return; }
311:     this._edgePending = true;
312:     this.speaking = true;
313:     const ws = new WebSocket(`${EDGE_WSS}?TrustedClientToken=${EDGE_TOKEN}&ConnectionId=${this._uuid()}`);
314:     this._edgeWs = ws;
315:     const chunks = [];
316:     let audioChunk = false;
317:     const fail = () => { this._cleanupEdge(); cb(false); };
318:     this._edgeTimer = setTimeout(fail, EDGE_TIMEOUT);
319:     ws.onopen = () => {
320:       this._markSource('edge');
321:       const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, '.0000');
322:       ws.send('X-Timestamp:' + ts + '\r\nContent-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\nPath:speech.config\r\n\r\n'
323:         + '{"context":{"synthesis":{"audio":{"metadataoptions":{"sentenceBoundaryEnabled":"false","wordBoundaryEnabled":"true"},"outputFormat":"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3"}}}}');
324:       const voice = profile.edge || 'ru-RU-DmitryNeural';
325:       const ratePct = Math.round((this._clamp(profile.rate !== undefined ? profile.rate : 1, 0.5, 2) - 1) * 100);
326:       const pitchHz = Math.round((this._clamp(profile.pitch !== undefined ? profile.pitch : 1, 0.2, 3) - 1) * 100);
327:       const ssml = "<speak version='1.0' xml:lang='ru-RU'><voice name='" + voice + "'><prosody pitch='" + pitchHz + "Hz' rate='" + ratePct + "%' volume='+0%'>"
328:         + this._esc(line) + '</prosody></voice></speak>';
329:       ws.send('X-RequestId:' + this._uuid() + '\r\nContent-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\nX-Timestamp:' + ts + '\r\nPath:ssml\r\n\r\n' + ssml);
330:     };
331:     ws.onmessage = (ev) => {
332:       if (typeof ev.data === 'string') {
333:         if (ev.data.indexOf('Path:turn.end') >= 0) {
334:           if (this._edgeTimer) { clearTimeout(this._edgeTimer); this._edgeTimer = null; }
335:           this._playEdgeAudio(chunks, profile, cb);
336:         }
337:         return;
338:       }
339:       const bufPromise = ev.data instanceof Blob ? ev.data.arrayBuffer() : Promise.resolve(ev.data);
340:       bufPromise.then((ab) => {
341:         const arr = new Uint8Array(ab);
342:         let idx = 0;
343:         let audioStart = -1;
344:         while (idx < arr.length) {
345:           const nl = arr.indexOf(0x0a, idx);
346:           if (nl < 0) { idx = arr.length; break; }
347:           const line = String.fromCharCode.apply(null, arr.subarray(idx, nl)).trim();
348:           if (line.length === 0) { audioStart = nl + 1; break; }
349:           if (line.indexOf('Path:audio') >= 0) audioChunk = true;
350:           idx = nl + 1;
351:         }
352:         if (audioChunk && audioStart >= 0 && audioStart < arr.length) {
353:           const chunk = arr.subarray(audioStart);
354:           chunks.push(chunk.buffer.slice(chunk.byteOffset, chunk.byteOffset + chunk.byteLength));
355:         }
356:         audioChunk = false;
357:       }).catch(() => {});
358:     };
359:     ws.onerror = fail;
360:     ws.onclose = () => {
361:       if (this._edgeTimer) { clearTimeout(this._edgeTimer); this._edgeTimer = null; }
362:       if (!this._edgeDone) cb(false);
363:     };
364:   }
365: 
366:   _playEdgeAudio(chunks, profile, cb) {
367:     this._cleanupEdge();
368:     if (!chunks.length) { cb(false); return; }
369:     const mp3 = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'audio/mpeg' });
370:     mp3.arrayBuffer().then((buf) => this._playBuf(buf, cb, 'edge', true)).catch(() => cb(false));
371:   }

373:   // self-hosted OpenAI-compatible Edge TTS relay (/v1/audio/speech)
374:   _relaySpeech(line, profile, cb) {
375:     this._markSource('edge');
376:     const base = String(this._edgeRelay).replace(/\/+$/, '');
377:     fetch(base + '/v1/audio/speech', {
378:       method: 'POST',
379:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
380:       body: JSON.stringify({
381:         model: 'edge-tts',
382:         input: line,
383:         voice: profile.edge || 'ru-RU-DmitryNeural',
384:         rate: this._clamp(profile.rate !== undefined ? profile.rate : 1, 0.5, 2),
385:         pitch: this._clamp(profile.pitch !== undefined ? profile.pitch : 1, 0.2, 3),
386:         response_format: 'mp3',
387:       }),
388:     }).then((res) => {
389:       if (!res.ok) throw new Error('relay ' + res.status);
390:       return res.arrayBuffer();
391:     }).then((buf) => {
392:       this._playBuf(buf, cb, 'edge', true);
393:     }).catch(() => cb(false));
394:   }

396:   _playBuf(buf, cb, source, wholeLine = false) {
397:     if (source) this._markSource(source);
398:     const ctx = this.audio.ctx || (this.audio.init(), this.audio.ctx);
399:     if (!ctx) { cb(false); return; }
400:     ctx.decodeAudioData(buf).then((audioBuf) => {
401:       // если контекст/буфер не годятся — честно отказываемся, но не падаем:
402:       // иначе реплика произносится дважды разными движками
403:       if (!audioBuf) { cb(false); return; }
404:       let started = false;
405:       try {
406:         const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
407:         src.buffer = audioBuf;
408:         const g = ctx.createGain();
409:         g.gain.value = this.audio.muted ? 0 : 0.55;
410:         src.connect(g).connect(this.audio.master || ctx.destination);
411:         this.speaking = true;
412:         this._source = src;
413:         src.onended = () => {
414:           this.speaking = false;
415:           this._source = null;
416:           if (wholeLine) this._finishLine();
417:         };
418:         if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();
419:         src.start();
420:         started = true;
421:       } catch (e) {
422:         this.speaking = false;
423:         this._source = null;
424:       }
425:       cb(started);
426:     }).catch(() => { this.speaking = false; cb(false); });
427:   }

429:   // имя движка, который реально озвучил последнюю реплику (для настроек)
430:   _markSource(name) { this.lastSource = name; }

432:   sourceName() {
433:     if (this.lastSource === 'android') return 'Системный голос Android';
434:     if (this.lastSource === 'edge') return 'Edge TTS';
435:     if (this.lastSource === 'google') return 'Google TTS';
436:     if (this.lastSource === 'web') return 'Web Speech (браузер)';
437:     if (this.lastSource === 'synth') return 'Локальный синтезатор';
438:     return '—';
439:   }

441:   _cleanupEdge() {
442:     if (this._edgeTimer) { clearTimeout(this._edgeTimer); this._edgeTimer = null; }
443:     if (this._edgeWs) {
444:       this._edgeDone = true;
445:       try { this._edgeWs.close(); } catch (e) {}
446:       this._edgeWs = null;
447:     }
448:   }

450:   // --- 3. Системные голоса устройства: Android TextToSpeech → Web Speech → synth ---
451:   _speakWebThenSynth(line, profile) {
452:     const bridge = this.androidTTS;
453:     if (this.supportedAndroid && bridge) {
454:       this.speaking = true;
455:       const rate = this._clamp(profile.rate !== undefined ? profile.rate : 1, 0.5, 2);
456:       const pitch = this._clamp(profile.pitch !== undefined ? profile.pitch : 1, 0.5, 2);
457:       const ok = bridge.speak(line, rate, pitch);
458:       if (ok !== false) {
459:         this._markSource('android');
460:         // мост вызывает window.__ttsDone() по окончании реплики; подстрахуемся
461:         // таймером, чтобы флаг speaking не залип навсегда
462:         if (this._ttsTimer) clearTimeout(this._ttsTimer);
463:         const estMs = Math.max(1500, String(line).length * 95);
464:         this._ttsTimer = setTimeout(() => {
465:           this._ttsTimer = null;
466:           if (this.speaking && this.lastSource === 'android') this._finishLine();
467:         }, estMs + 4000);
468:         return;
469:       }
470:       this.speaking = false;
471:     }
472:     if (!this.supportedWeb) { this._speakSynth(line, profile); return; }
473:     this.speaking = true;
474:     try {
475:       const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(line);
476:       u.lang = 'ru-RU';
477:       u.volume = this.audio.muted ? 0 : 1;
478:       u.rate = this._clamp(profile.rate !== undefined ? profile.rate : 1, 0.5, 2);
479:       u.pitch = this._clamp(profile.pitch !== undefined ? profile.pitch : 1, 0, 2);
480:       const v = this._pickVoice(profile);
481:       if (v) u.voice = v;
482:       this._markSource('web');
483:       u.onend = () => { this._finishLine(); };
484:       u.onerror = () => {
485:         this.speaking = false;
486:         this._speakSynth(line, profile);
487:       };
488:       this.synth.speak(u);
489:     } catch (e) {
490:       this.speaking = false;
491:       this._speakSynth(line, profile);
492:     }
493:   }

495:   _pickVoice(profile) {
496:     if (!this.synth || !this.voices.length) return null;
497:     const rus = this.voices.filter(v => /ru/i.test(v.lang || ''));
498:     const pool = rus.length ? rus : this.voices;
499:     const mask = ((profile && profile.mask) || this.profile || '').toLowerCase().trim();
500:     if (mask) {
501:       for (const v of pool) {
502:         if (v.name.toLowerCase().includes(mask)) return v;
503:       }
504:     }
505:     return pool[0];
506:   }

508:   // --- 3. WebAudio "declaimer" fallback ---
509:   _speakSynth(line, profile) {
510:     const ctx = this.audio.ctx || (this.audio.init(), this.audio.ctx);
511:     if (!ctx) { this.speaking = false; return; }
512:     this.speaking = true;
513:     this._markSource('synth');
514:     const p = Object.assign({ base: -2, rate: 1, waveform: 'sine', pitch: 1, jitter: 0.08, echo: 0, volume: 0.3 }, profile);
515:     const rising = /[?？]\s*$/.test(line);
516:     const exclaim = /[!！]\s*$/.test(line);
517:     const ellipsis = /(\.\.\.|…)\s*$/.test(line);
518:     const words = line.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
519:     const sPerWord = 0.55 / p.rate;
520:     let t = ctx.currentTime + 0.02;
521:     for (const w of words) {
522:       const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(4, Math.ceil(w.length / 3)));
523:       const per = sPerWord / n;
524:       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
525:         this._blip(ctx, p, w, i, n, t + per * i, per, { rising, exclaim, ellipsis });
526:       }
527:       if (/[.!?…]/.test(w[w.length - 1])) {
528:         if (ellipsis) t += 0.34;
529:         else if (/[!?]/.test(w[w.length - 1])) t += 0.26;
530:         else t += 0.2;
531:       }
532:       t += sPerWord;
533:     }
534:     const end = t + 0.2;
535:     this._synthTimer = setTimeout(() => { this._finishLine(); }, (end - ctx.currentTime) * 1000);
536:   }
537: 
538:   _blip(ctx, p, word, i, n, t, dur, mood) {
539:     if (this.audio.muted) return;
540:     const master = this.audio.master || ctx.destination;
541:     const freqBase = NOTE * Math.pow(2, (p.base || 0) / 12) * (p.pitch || 1);
542:     const lastSyl = i === n - 1;
543:     const accent = lastSyl ? 1.12 : (i === 0 ? 1.0 : 0.93);
544:     const jit = 1 + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (p.jitter || 0.1);
545:     let f0 = freqBase * accent * jit;
546:     let f1 = f0 * (lastSyl && mood.rising ? 1.3 : mood.exclaim ? 1.18 : 0.88);
547:     if (lastSyl && mood.ellipsis) f1 = f0 * 0.7;
548:     f0 = Math.max(30, f0);
549:     f1 = Math.max(30, f1);
550: 
551:     const g = ctx.createGain();
552:     g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
553:     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.00015, p.volume || 0.3), t + dur * 0.3);
554:     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur + 0.02);
555: 
556:     const o = ctx.createOscillator();
557:     o.type = p.waveform || 'sine';
558:     o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, t);
559:     o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f1, t + dur * 0.9);
560: 
561:     const bpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
562:     bpf.type = 'bandpass';
563:     bpf.frequency.value = f0 * 2.1;
564:     bpf.Q.value = 5;
565:     o.connect(bpf).connect(g).connect(master);
566: 
567:     if (p.echo > 0) {
568:       const d = ctx.createDelay(0.7);
569:       d.delayTime.value = 0.2;
570:       const eg = ctx.createGain();
571:       eg.gain.value = (p.volume || 0.3) * 0.4 * p.echo;
572:       g.connect(d);
573:       d.connect(eg).connect(master);
574:     }
575: 
576:     o.start(t);
577:     o.stop(t + dur + 0.05);
578: 
579:     if (i === 0) this._noiseBurst(ctx, t, dur * 0.4, f0 * 2.4, (p.volume || 0.3) * 0.45);
580:   }
581: 
582:   _noiseBurst(ctx, t, dur, freq, gainV) {
583:     const len = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * dur));
584:     const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, len, ctx.sampleRate);
585:     const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
586:     for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / len);
587:     const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
588:     src.buffer = buf;
589:     const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
590:     f.type = 'bandpass';
591:     f.frequency.value = freq;
592:     const g = ctx.createGain();
593:     g.gain.value = gainV;
594:     src.connect(f).connect(g).connect(this.audio.master || ctx.destination);

parts.text:
Bugs in VoiceEngine:

1. `capabilities()` returns `edge: this.supportedEdge` — supportedEdge is a getter, so `this.supportedEdge` invokes the getter. Correct.

2. `previewVoice` in Game.js: `this.voice.speak('...', { mask: ..., rate: 0.95, pitch: 1 })` — no `queue` option, so it calls `this.stop()` then dispatch. Then the timeout at 1200ms: `if (!this.voice.speaking) this.voice.setEnabled(false);`. With google TTS, at 1.2s it's likely still speaking → voice stays enabled forever. Real bug: the preview leaks the "enable" state. Fix: use `u.onend`-ish. Simplest robust fix: always re-disable after a bounded delay, or check again. Better: in previewVoice, restore `wasEnabled` in a callback when the line finishes. We can poll: use setInterval checking `!this.voice.speaking` and then restore. I'll implement a small polling loop that turns it off once speech ends (with a hard cap).

3. `speak(line, profile, opts)`: `if (opts.queue && this.speaking) { this._queue.push(...) }`. But `stop()` clears the queue. OK.

4. `_speakGoogle` → `playNext` → when a chunk fails, `this.speaking = false; cb(false)` → then `_speakWebThenSynth` — ok.

5. `_speakGoogle` for chunks: `_finishLine()` is called then `cb(true)`. `_finishLine` may start the next queued line, then `cb(true)`... fine.

6. `_googleDirect`: `a.volume = this.audio.muted ? 0 : 1;` fine.

7. `notifyDone()` — `if (this._ttsTimer) {clearTimeout...}` then `_finishLine()`. If the Android bridge never calls back and the timer fires, it calls `_finishLine` too — could double-finish: timer set → bridge calls __ttsDone → clears timer → _finishLine. Then also... no, timer cleared. But if the timer already fired and set `_ttsTimer = null` and `_finishLine()`, then later the bridge calls `__ttsDone` → `_finishLine()` again → double-finish, potentially skipping a queue item. Edge case; guard with `if (!this.speaking) return;`. Reasonable defensive fix.

8. `setProfile(profile)`: `if (profile)` — so `setProfile('')` does nothing. Game calls `onVoiceProfileChange: (profile) => this.voice.setProfile(profile)`. If a user picks "default/none", nothing happens. Minor.

9. `stop()` doesn't clear `_ttsTimer`. `stop()` is called by `setEnabled(false)`, `setMode`, `speak` before dispatch. The `_ttsTimer` is for the Android bridge fallback. If `stop()` is called while android speech is pending, `_ttsTimer` remains and later fires → `if (this.speaking && ...)` → speaking false → no-op. OK, minor. Actually `stop()` should clear `_ttsTimer` for cleanliness.

10. In `_speakSynth`: `this._synthTimer = setTimeout(...)`. `_killSynth` clears. But `stop()` → `_killSynth()`. OK.

11. `_playBuf`: `const ctx = this.audio.ctx || (this.audio.init(), this.audio.ctx);` — comma operator inside `||`. Valid JS. OK.

parts.text:
Bugs in Traffic.js:

1. `updateTraffic` playerDriven branch: `m.position.x += Math.sin(m.rotation.y) * sp;` — but for the cab, the horse heads toward +z... The car is modeled facing +z (hood at z=1.62, headlights at z=2.16). So forward = +z → direction (sin(rot), cos(rot)). Correct.

2. `buildTraffic`: `mesh.position.set(rt.fixed + (rt.spawnBoost ? Math.sin(i*7) : 0), 0, start)`. OK, weird but fine.

3. In the playerDriven branch for cab: `m.userData.legs` exists. OK. For non-cab: uses m.userData.wheels. OK.

4. **Real bug**: In the playerDriven branch, the vehicle never wraps at route min/max — it drives off forever. That's intended for player driving (they steer). But `Game.dismount` uses `v.fixed` and `v.axis`, so it works.

5. In the cab branch (non-playerDriven) the wheels spin twice: once in the general loop with `/0.32` and again inside the cab branch with `/0.45`. Double spin — minor visual bug, wheels spin ~1.4x too fast for the cab. Eh, this is intentional-looking ("harness sway" comment is wrong). It's a minor visual inconsistency. I could leave it. Actually it's a legit small bug: cab wheels spin at 1/0.32 + 1/0.45 ≈ 3.125 + 2.22 = 5.35 per unit speed, while other vehicles spin at 3.125. So the cab's wheels rotate ~1.7x too fast. Minor visual. Low priority but trivially fixable (remove the extra spin).

6. `updateTraffic` when playerDriven with `c.speed` could be 0 → fine.

Now, a real issue: in `updateTraffic` non-driven axis 'z' branch, `m.position.set(c.fixed, 0, z)` — resets y to 0 each frame, then later `m.position.y = ...` for the sway. Fine.

265: export function updatePedestrians(peds, props, dt, t, playerPos = null, weather = null) {
266:   const rain = weather ? weather.rain || 0 : 0;
267:   const wind = weather ? weather.wind || 0 : 0;
268:   for (const p of peds || []) {
269:     const fig = p.fig;
270: 
271:     // ---------- walkers ----------
272:     if (p.activity === null) {
273:       let moving = false;
274:       p.weatherPauseCd = (p.weatherPauseCd || 0) - dt;
275:       if (rain > 0.38 && p.weatherPauseCd <= 0) {
276:         p.pauseT = Math.max(p.pauseT, 0.7 + Math.random() * 1.4);
277:         p.weatherPauseCd = 2.8 + Math.random() * 3.5;
278:       }
279:       if (p.pauseT > 0) {
280:         p.pauseT -= dt;
281:       } else {
282:         const len = p.wp.length;
283:         let ti = p.i + p.dir;
284:         if (ti < 0) ti = 0;
285:         if (ti >= len) ti = len - 1;
286:         const a = p.wp[p.i], b = p.wp[ti];
287:         const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z;
288:         const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
289:         if (dist < 0.001) { p.i = ti; continue; }
290:         const moveSpeed = p.speed * (1 - rain * 0.55);
291:         fig.g.position.x += (dx / dist) * moveSpeed * dt;
292:         fig.g.position.z += (dz / dist) * moveSpeed * dt;
293:         fig.g.rotation.y = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
294:         p.phase += dt * moveSpeed * 3.2;
295:         moving = true;
296:         const nx = b.x - fig.g.position.x, nz = b.z - fig.g.position.z;
297:         if (nx * nx + nz * nz < 0.08) {
298:           p.i = ti;
299:           if (p.i <= 0) { p.dir = 1; p.pauseT = 0.6 + Math.random() * 2.2; }
300:           else if (p.i >= len - 1) { p.dir = -1; p.pauseT = 0.6 + Math.random() * 2.2; }
301:         }
302:       }
303:       // своя походка: длина шага и частота зависят от телосложения
304:       const gait = p.body ? p.body.gait : 3.2;
305:       const stride = 0.5 + (p.body ? (p.body.height - 0.86) * 0.35 : 0.1);
306:       fig.legL.rotation.x = moving ? Math.sin(p.phase) * stride : Math.sin(t * 2 + p.phase) * 0.06;
307:       fig.legR.rotation.x = moving ? -Math.sin(p.phase) * stride : -Math.sin(t * 2 + p.phase) * 0.06;
308:       fig.armL.rotation.x = moving ? -Math.sin(p.phase) * 0.5 : Math.sin(t * 1.5 + p.phase) * 0.08;
309:       fig.armR.rotation.x = moving ? Math.sin(p.phase) * 0.5 : Math.sin(t * 1.5 + p.phase) * 0.08;
310:       fig.g.position.y = moving ? Math.abs(Math.sin(p.phase * gait / 3.2)) * 0.04 : Math.sin(t * 1.3 + p.phase) * 0.015;
311:       // живой прохожий: смотрит на игрока, если тот рядом, и поворачивает голову
312:       if (playerPos) {
313:         const ddx = playerPos.x - fig.g.position.x;
314:         const ddz = playerPos.z - fig.g.position.z;
315:         if (ddx * ddx + ddz * ddz < 36) {
316:           p.glanceCd -= dt;
317:           if (p.glance <= 0 && p.glanceCd <= 0) {
318:             p.glance = 1.2 + Math.random() * 1.6;
319:             p.glanceCd = 5 + Math.random() * 9;
320:           }
321:         }
322:       }
323:       if (p.glance > 0) {
324:         p.glance -= dt;
325:         const look = playerPos ? Math.atan2(playerPos.x - fig.g.position.x, playerPos.z - fig.g.position.z) : fig.g.rotation.y;
326:         let rel = look - fig.g.rotation.y;
327:         while (rel > Math.PI) rel -= Math.PI * 2;
328:         while (rel < -Math.PI) rel += Math.PI * 2;
329:         const lookAmt = Math.max(-0.9, Math.min(0.9, rel));
330:         fig.headG.rotation.y = lookAmt * 0.8;
331:         fig.g.rotation.y += lookAmt * 0.1 * Math.min(1, dt * 3);
332:       } else if (fig.headG) {
333:         fig.headG.rotation.y *= Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 4);
334:       }
335:     }
336: 
337:     // ---------- activity figures ----------
338:     if (p.activity === 'feeder') {
339:       fig.g.rotation.y = Math.atan2(-1.5, -2) - Math.PI / 2;
340:       const crouch = 0.12 + Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 0.8 + p.phase)) * 0.1;
341:       fig.armR.rotation.x = -0.9 - crouch * 2;
342:       fig.armL.rotation.x = -0.4;
343:       fig.g.position.y = Math.sin(t * 1.1 + p.phase) * 0.02;
344:     } else if (p.activity === 'sweep') {
345:       const s = p.extras;
346:       const sweep = 0.35 + Math.sin(t * 0.9 + p.phase) * 0.2;
347:       s.brush.rotation.z = 0.25 + Math.sin(t * 1.6 + p.phase) * 0.12;
348:       s.brush.position.y = 1.55 + Math.sin(t * 1.6 + p.phase) * 0.08;
349:       s.bristles.position.y = 2.4 + Math.sin(t * 1.6 + p.phase) * 0.08;
350:       fig.armL.rotation.x = sweep;
351:       fig.armR.rotation.x = -sweep;
352:       fig.g.position.y = Math.sin(t * 1.2 + p.phase) * 0.03;
353:     } else if (p.activity === 'newsboy') {
354:       const wave = Math.sin(t * 1.4 + p.phase);
355:       fig.armR.rotation.x = -0.6 + wave * 0.35;
356:       fig.armR.rotation.z = -0.3 + wave * 0.08;
357:       fig.armL.rotation.x = 0.15;
358:       fig.g.position.y = Math.sin(t * 1.3 + p.phase) * 0.025;
359:     } else if (p.activity === 'fish') {
360:       const rock = Math.sin(t * 1.1 + p.phase) * 0.06;
361:       fig.body.rotation.z = rock;
362:       fig.armL.rotation.x = Math.sin(t * 1.1 + p.phase) * 0.3;
363:       fig.armR.rotation.x = -Math.sin(t * 1.1 + p.phase) * 0.3;
364:       fig.g.position.y = Math.sin(t * 1.2 + p.phase) * 0.02;
365:     }
366: 
367:     const weatherPoseTarget = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (rain - 0.18) / 0.62));
368:     p.weatherPose = (p.weatherPose || 0) + (weatherPoseTarget - (p.weatherPose || 0)) * Math.min(1, dt * 5);
369:     fig.headG.rotation.x = p.weatherPose * 0.42;
370:     fig.body.rotation.x = p.weatherPose * 0.08;
371:     fig.armL.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(fig.armL.rotation.x, -0.68, p.weatherPose);
372:     fig.armR.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(fig.armR.rotation.x, -0.52, p.weatherPose);
373:     fig.armL.rotation.z = p.weatherPose * 0.22;
374:     fig.armR.rotation.z = -p.weatherPose * 0.22;
375:     fig.headG.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 4 + p.phase) * wind * 0.035;
376:   }
377: 
378:   // pigeons hop-peck
379:   for (const pg of (props && props.pigeons) || []) {
380:     const tt = t * 2.2 + pg.phase;
381:     const activity = 1 - rain * 0.82;
382:     pg.g.position.y = Math.max(0, Math.sin(tt)) * 0.06 * activity;
383:     if (Math.sin(tt) > 0.96) pg.g.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 3.1 + pg.phase * 2) * 0.6 * activity;
384:     pg.g.rotation.x = Math.max(0, Math.sin(tt + 1.6)) * 0.5 * activity;
385:     pg.g.position.x = pg.x + Math.sin(t * 0.4 + pg.phase) * 0.25 * activity;
386:     pg.g.position.z = pg.z + Math.cos(t * 0.35 + pg.phase * 1.3) * 0.25 * activity;
387:   }
388: 
389:   // gulls circle
390:   for (const glide of (props && props.gulls) || []) {
391:     const a = t * (0.5 + rain * 0.35) + glide.phase;
392:     const rg = 3.5 + Math.sin(t * 0.3 + glide.phase) * 1.2;
393:     glide.g.position.x = 218 + Math.cos(a) * rg;
394:     glide.g.position.z = 127 + Math.sin(a) * rg;
395:     glide.g.position.y = 4.5 - rain * 1.4 + Math.sin(t * 0.9 + glide.phase) * 0.4;
396:     glide.g.rotation.y = -a + Math.PI / 2;
397:     const flap = Math.sin(t * 6 + glide.phase) * 0.5;
398:     for (const w of glide.wings) w.rotation.z = flap;
399:   }
400: 
401:   // sleeping market cat — soft breathing + slow tail flick
402:   if (props && props.cat) {
403:     const breathe = 1 + Math.sin(t * 2.3) * 0.02;
404:     props.cat.scale.set(2 - breathe, breathe * 0.96, 1);
405:     const tail = props.cat.userData.tail;
406:     if (tail) tail.rotation.z = 0.9 + Math.sin(t * 1.1) * 0.18;
407:   }
408: }

Bugs in Pedestrians.js:

1. `citizenFigure`: `const b = new THREE.Mesh(flatGeometry(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.15, 10, 7).scale(1, 0.45, 1)), hatMat);` — `flatGeometry(...)` then `.scale()`? Actually `new THREE.SphereGeometry(...).scale(1,0.45,1)` returns the geometry (BufferGeometry.scale returns this). Then flatGeometry is applied to the scaled geometry. Wait, `flatGeometry(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.15, 10, 7).scale(1, 0.45, 1))` — the `.scale()` is called on the geometry first, then flatGeometry is called on the result. OK fine.

2. `updatePedestrians` for walkers: `if (p.activity === null)`. The activity figures skip the walker block. Then at the bottom, the weather pose is applied to ALL peds including activity ones — and it lerps armL/armR rotations which are also set in the activity block. Order: activity block sets arm rotations, then the weather block lerps them toward -0.68/-0.52. OK, intentional.

3. **Bug**: in the walker block, when `p.pauseT > 0` the ped doesn't move, and the code at the bottom sets legL.rotation.x etc. Fine.

4. **Bug**: `if (dist < 0.001) { p.i = ti; continue; }` — `continue` skips the rest including the weather pose for this ped. Minor.

5. **Bug in `p.pauseT` handling**: when reaching the end, `p.dir` flips. Fine.

6. Notable: `fig.g.position.y = moving ? ... : ...` but the weather pose is applied after. OK.

7. **Real bug**: `updatePedestrians(peds, props, dt, t, playerPos, weather)` — In Game.animateProps: `updatePedestrians(this.world.peds, this.world.pedsProps, dt, t, this.player.pos, this.weatherContext)`. OK.

8. `props.sweep`, `props.newsboy`, `props.fish` set but unused. Fine.

9. In the 'sweep' activity: `s.brush.rotation.z = ...` and earlier `brush.rotation.x = -0.6` set at build. Fine.

Now — one important thing: in `Game.updateCrowd` and `playerAttack`, they check `ped.activity !== null` to skip activity figures. And `ped._bump`/`_bumpReached` are undefined initially → `if (ped._bumpReached) continue;` — undefined → falsy → proceeds. OK.

`if (this._crowdBumpCooldown <= 0 ...)` — `this._crowdBumpCooldown` is initially undefined → `undefined <= 0` is false! So the first crowd bump never speaks. After `if (this._crowdBumpCooldown) this._crowdBumpCooldown -= dt;` → undefined stays undefined. So `_crowdBumpCooldown` is NEVER initialized and never set to a number until the branch sets it to 2.5. So the first time the player bumps a ped, no phrase; from then on it works. Minor bug: should init to 0. Real but tiny.

Now let's read the UI files.

parts.text:
Bugs in Screens.js:

1. **`btn-map` and `btn-menu` get TWO click listeners**: line 29-30 in the constructor and lines 434-435 in `setHud`. `setHud` is called by Game after constructing Screens. So clicking "map" or "menu" fires the hook TWICE → `toggleMap()` twice → opens and immediately closes the map! That's a real, user-visible bug.

Let me verify: `Game` constructor: `this.screens = new Screens({...})` then `this.screens.setHud(this.hud)`. Yes! Both the constructor (lines 29-30) and setHud (434-435) attach listeners to the same buttons. So `btn-map` click → onMap() twice → toggleMap() → mode 'explore' → 'map' (showMap), then second call: mode==='map' → 'explore' + hideMap. Net effect: the map never opens. Same for the pause menu button: togglePause sets mode='pause'; the second call checks `if (this.mode === 'explore')` → false → no-op. So the pause menu works by luck.

This is a definite bug. Fix: remove the duplicate registration in `setHud` (or the constructor). I'll remove the ones in `setHud` since `setHud`'s purpose is the save/continue HUD buttons.

2. `refreshVoiceProfiles` — the `edge` profile list has 'ru-RU-DmitryNeural' but `VoiceEngine._speakEdge` uses `profile.edge || 'ru-RU-DmitryNeural'`, and `setProfile(profile)` sets `this.profile = 'ru-RU-DmitryNeural'`, then `_dispatch(line, profile)` — wait, in `speak(line, profile)`, profile is the passed arg. In `onDialogueSpeak`: `this.voice.speak(d.text, voiceFor(d.speaker), ...)` — so profile comes from `voiceFor()`, not from `this.profile`. Hmm, so the selected profile in settings (`this.profile`) is only used in `_pickVoice` (web). For edge, `profile.edge` comes from the passed profile. So the "voice engine/profile" selector for Edge/Google has no effect... For google, `profile.rate`/`profile.tl` are used. Meh. `this.profile` is basically only used by `_pickVoice`. Design issue, not clearly a bug.

3. `refreshVoiceProfiles` for engine 'google' — ok.

Now HUD, Minimap, MapUI, CombatUI, DialogueUI, Cinematic, Tutorial, Combat, cards/data, story/*.

Minimap bugs:

1. **The map doesn't rotate but the world markers don't rotate either** — it draws fixed offsets then rotates only the player triangle. The comment says "rotate minimap to match camera yaw" but the world markers are drawn in screen space without rotation. So the player triangle rotates but the world doesn't → misleading. Hmm, this could be a real bug (the minimap claims to be camera-relative but the world is drawn north-up). But the compass ring also uses camYaw. So the compass rotates but the world doesn't. This is inconsistent: if the map were north-up, the compass shouldn't rotate. This is a design decision, ambiguous. I'd leave it — it's a visual choice, though arguably a bug. Actually, since the compass letters rotate with camYaw while world features don't, the compass would point to the wrong landmark. E.g., with camYaw = π (default at start), 'С' (North) is drawn at angle -π → x = cx + sin(-π)*R = cx, y = cy - cos(-π)*R = cy + R → bottom of the minimap. So North is displayed at the bottom, and it's fixed regardless of world rotation. If the world markers are north-up (z decreasing = north?), then having north at the bottom is wrong. Hmm, but world -Z is up on the minimap (pz = cy + (z - pz)*scale, so smaller z → up on screen). If -Z is "North" (С), then North should be at the TOP of the map. With camYaw=π, the compass puts 'С' at the bottom. That's a definite inconsistency/bug.

Hmm. Which is "correct"? The intent seems: rotate the map so the player's view direction is up, and the compass ring shows which way is N. The world markers should then be rotated too. The cleanest minimal fix: rotate the world layer by -camYaw around the center and keep the compass ring static... but then the compass ring's letters need to rotate with the map (they do rotate by -camYaw, which would then be double). 

Ugh, this is getting deep into design. The minimal defensible fix: apply the same rotation to the world layer (markers + grid) as to the player triangle, which is what the code comment claims to do. That would make the compass consistent: the map rotates with the camera, and N is drawn at the angle -camYaw which is the direction of North relative to the camera view. Let's verify: with the map rotated by -camYaw (i.e., everything drawn rotated by -camYaw about the center), a world point at world-direction North (which is drawn at (0,-1) in the unrotated frame) appears rotated. In the unrotated frame, North = (0,-1) in canvas coords (up). After rotating the whole canvas by -camYaw, the North marker is at angle... and the compass draws 'С' at (sin(-camYaw), -cos(-camYaw)) * R, i.e. the same rotation applied to (0,-1). So yes — if the world layer is rotated by -camYaw, the compass correctly labels the world directions. Currently the world isn't rotated, so the compass lies.

So the fix: wrap the world drawing (grid, zones, items, NPCs, wisps, vehicle) in a `ctx.translate(cx, cy); ctx.rotate(-camYaw); ctx.translate(-cx, -cy);` when rotateMap is true. That's a moderate change but well-defined and clearly fixes an inconsistency. Risk: moderate. Benefit: fixes a visibly wrong compass. I think this is worth doing, and it's a genuine bug ("compass ring doesn't match the map"). Hmm, but if the map is intentionally north-up, the fix is to make the compass static instead. Which one? The code comment explicitly says "rotate minimap to match camera yaw in orbit/fps modes" — the author intended camera-relative. And the compass is designed to rotate. So the world layer missing the rotation is the bug. I'll fix it that way.

Also note: the player triangle points "up" in map space, and with rotate applied, the triangle stays pointing up while the map rotates → the player faces the top of the map = camera-forward. Consistent with camera-relative. Good.

2. `resize()`: `this.size = rect.width || 140` and the canvas gets `width = size*dpr`. In `render`, `ctx.clearRect(0,0,s,s)` with the dpr transform set. Fine.

3. `update(dt)` just stores lastPlayerPos. `this.lastPlayerPos` unused otherwise. Dead.

4. `Minimap.render()` is called from `Game.loop()` unconditionally, but returns early unless mode==='explore'. OK.

5. `zones` drawing: `z.color.replace('0.12','0.25')` — fine.

6. `n.name[0]` — if name is empty, undefined → fillText(undefined) → "undefined". NPC names exist. Fine.

parts.text:
Combat.js bugs:

1. `canPlay(i)`: `return this.energy >= CARDS[cardId].cost;` — if the card id isn't in CARDS (e.g., a bad save with a bad deck id), it throws. `this.deck` comes from `d.deck` in loadGame without validation → `CARDS[id]` undefined → crash in canPlay/inventoryData. Actually `inventoryData` filters with `.filter(Boolean)`. But `combatDeck = [...this.deck]` → `draw()` → hand could include an unknown card → `canPlay` throws → game breaks. Defensive fix: filter the loaded deck to known card ids. Real robustness bug (a corrupted/old save breaks the game permanently). Worth fixing: in loadGame, filter `d.deck` by `CARDS`.

2. `endTurn()`: after the enemy's attack, `this.enemy.block` never resets! Let me check... `endTurn` doesn't reset `this.enemy.block`. Hmm, where is enemy.block reset? Nowhere! `startCombat` sets block = def.block. `play` reduces it when absorbing damage. So block accumulates permanently across the whole fight? Well, it's never increased, so it only depletes. Not a huge deal, but if the intent says "attack" and the enemy had block... The intent has only name/atk. OK so block is just a starting shield. Fine.

3. `play()` → `if (this.enemy.hp <= 0) this.finishWin();` — then `onCombatPlay` in Game: `if (this.combat.over) this.combatUI.render(...)`, then render again, then `resolveCombat()`. In resolveCombat → won → endCombatCleanup → `this.combat = null; this.mode='explore'`. OK.

4. `endTurn()` — `this.turn++` — `turn` is used in canPlay as `this.turn === 'enemy'` which is never true (turn is a number). Dead check, harmless.

5. `drawUntil(5)` — hand never discards played cards? They go to discard. Fine.

6. In `endTurn`, `this.state.hp` reduced but `player.hp` is only synced in resolveCombat. In `Game.onCombatEndTurn` there's no hp sync to player. If the player loses... finishLose → over → resolveCombat → not won → showResult. Then the player clicks "retry"/"give up"/"title". `onCombatGiveUp` → deathPenalty(10) → `this.state.hp = Math.max(1, this.state.hp - hpPenalty); this.player.hp = this.state.hp;` OK. `onCombatRetry` → `this.state.hp = this.state.maxHp; this.player.hp = this.state.maxHp;` OK.

But if the player is at 0 HP and hits "retry", they get full HP — the intended "retry" behavior. Fine.

7. `retreat()` sets over=true, but `Game.onCombatFlee` doesn't call resolveCombat. Fine, it calls endCombatCleanup.

parts.text:
Bugs in Particles.js:

1. `ParticleField.follow(camPos)` computes `const bx = this.base[j] - this.anchor.x;` AFTER setting `this.anchor = camPos` — so bx is relative to the new anchor. Intent OK. But `follow()` is never called on any field! `Effects.follow(camPos)` only calls `this.rain.follow(...)`, and `Effects.update` calls `this.dust.update(...)` etc. The dust field's anchor stays at (0,0,0) forever, so dust is spread over ±300/±260 around the origin — fine for a big world. And `follow` for dust is dead code. Not a bug per se.

2. `ParticleField.update` for 'ember': duplicated `this.life[i] = 0;` twice. Trivial.

3. `RainField.update(dt)` is called as `this.rain.update(dt, t, camPos)` — extra args ignored. Fine.

4. `RainField.spawn(i)` — `this.groundY + 12 + Math.random()*16`. Fine.

5. `RainField.setShelter(weather.shelter || null)` — in Game, `weather.shelter` is the object from getShelterAt, `{indoor:true}` for indoor. `setShelter` → `shelter && !shelter.indoor ? shelter : null`. Fine.

6. `BurstPool.update`: `const jmax = this.count*3;` unused. Trivial.

7. `Effects.setWeather` sets `this.rainGroundY = groundY` and `follow()` uses `this.rainGroundY`. Fine.

8. `ParticleField.setIntensity` — `for (let i = this.activeCount; i < nextCount; i++) this.spawn(i, 0);` — for RainField: `this.spawn(i)`. OK.

9. `spawn(i, t)`: `this.life[i] = t * 0;` → always 0. Weird but works (NaN if t undefined? `t*0` with t=undefined = NaN!). In `follow()`: `this.spawn(i, 0)`? No, follow doesn't call spawn for ParticleField. In `reset()`: `this.spawn(i, 0)`. In update: `this.spawn(i, t)`. In setIntensity: `this.spawn(i, 0)`. All pass a number. OK.

10. `Effects.update` — `this.motes.update(dt, t, camPos)` with the anchor at {138, -40, -44} (cistern). Fine.

11. **`makeSoftTexture`**: `g.addColorStop(0.45, outer.replace('0)', '0.45)'))` — if outer is 'rgba(255,255,255,0)' → 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)'. Fine.

Now SkyDome, GlowSprites, HoloArena, Painterly, AnimeFigure.

parts.text:
Confirmed bug at line 143-145: `this.moveJoy(e)` then zeroes the vector. Note that `beginCamJoy` (line 106-107) does NOT call moveCamJoy, so it's consistent-but-different. For `beginJoy`, calling moveJoy then zeroing means the thumb is visually offset but the vector is 0 until the next pointermove event. On a tap-and-hold without moving, the player won't move — actually that's arguably intended ("tap to place then drag")? No: the thumb visually snaps to the finger position, so the player expects movement. The zeroing is clearly a bug: it discards the computed vector AND calls onMove(0,0) which sets `preferTouch = true` — fine, but the movement direction is lost until the finger moves. A player who touches and holds without moving expects to walk toward the touch point. Definite bug.

Fix: don't zero after moveJoy.

451:   _speakWebThenSynth(line, profile) {

453:     if (this.supportedAndroid && bridge) {
454:       this.speaking = true;
455:       const rate = this._clamp(profile.rate !== undefined ? profile.rate : 1, 0.5, 2);
456:       const pitch = this._clamp(profile.pitch !== undefined ? profile.pitch : 1, 0.5, 2);

495:   _pickVoice(profile) {

508:   // --- 3. WebAudio "declaimer" fallback ---
509:   _speakSynth(line, profile) {
510:     const ctx = this.audio.ctx || (this.audio.init(), this.audio.ctx);
511:     if (!ctx) { this.speaking = false; return; }
512:     this.speaking = true;
513:     this._markSource('synth');
514:     const p = Object.assign({ base: -2, rate: 1, waveform: 'sine', pitch: 1, jitter: 0.08, echo: 0, volume: 0.3 }, profile);
515:     const rising = /[?？]\s*$/.test(line);
516:     const exclaim = /[!！]\s*$/.test(line);
517:     const ellipsis = /(\.\.\.|…)\s*$/.test(line);
518:     const words = line.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
519:     const sPerWord = 0.55 / p.rate;
520:     let t = ctx.currentTime + 0.02;
521:     for (const w of words) {
522:       const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(4, Math.ceil(w.length / 3)));
523:       const per = sPerWord / n;
524:       for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
525:         this._blip(ctx, p, w, i, n, t + per * i, per, { rising, exclaim, ellipsis });
526:       }
527:       if (/[.!?…]/.test(w[w.length - 1])) {
528:         if (ellipsis) t += 0.34;
529:         else if (/[!?]/.test(w[w.length - 1])) t += 0.26;
530:         else t += 0.2;
531:       }
532:       t += sPerWord;

536:   }

538:   _blip(ctx, p, word, i, n, t, dur, mood) {
539:     if (this.audio.muted) return;
540:     const master = this.audio.master || ctx.destination;
541:     const freqBase = NOTE * Math.pow(2, (p.base || 0) / 12) * (p.pitch || 1);
542:     const lastSyl = i === n - 1;
543:     const accent = lastSyl ? 1.12 : (i === 0 ? 1.0 : 0.93);
544:     const jit = 1 + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (p.jitter || 0.1);
545:     let f0 = freqBase * accent * jit;
546:     let f1 = f0 * (lastSyl && mood.rising ? 1.3 : mood.exclaim ? 1.18 : 0.88);
547:     if (lastSyl && mood.ellipsis) f1 = f0 * 0.7;
548:     f0 = Math.max(30, f0);
549:     f1 = Math.max(30, f1);
550: 
551:     const g = ctx.createGain();
552:     g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
553:     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.00015, p.volume || 0.3), t + dur * 0.3);
554:     g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur + 0.02);
555: 
556:     const o = ctx.createOscillator();
557:     o.type = p.waveform || 'sine';
558:     o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, t);
559:     o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f1, t + dur * 0.9);
560: 
561:     const bpf = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
562:     bpf.type = 'bandpass';
563:     bpf.frequency.value = f0 * 2.1;
564:     bpf.Q.value = 5;
565:     o.connect(bpf).connect(g).connect(master);

567:     if (p.echo > 0) {
568:       const d = ctx.createDelay(0.7);
569:       d.delayTime.value = 0.2;
570:       const eg = ctx.createGain();
571:       eg.gain.value = (p.volume || 0.3) * 0.4 * p.echo;
572:       g.connect(d);
573:       d.connect(eg).connect(master);
574:     }
575: 
576:     o.start(t);
577:     o.stop(t + dur + 0.05);
578: 
579:     if (i === 0) this._noiseBurst(ctx, t, dur * 0.4, f0 * 2.4, (p.volume || 0.3) * 0.45);

582:   _noiseBurst(ctx, t, dur, freq, gainV) {
583:     const len = Math.max(1, Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * dur));

585:     const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
586:     for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / len);

588:     src.buffer = buf;
589:     const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
590:     f.type = 'bandpass';
591:     f.frequency.value = freq;
592:     const g = ctx.createGain();
593:     g.gain.value = gainV;
594:     src.connect(f).connect(g).connect(this.audio.master || ctx.destination);

The minimap rotation: the compass rotates with -camYaw, meaning the world layer should also be rotated by -camYaw for consistency. Currently the world layer is drawn unrotated, so the compass says N is up-ish but the map is north-up. That's an actual inconsistency. Fix: rotate the world layer (grid, zones, items, NPCs, wisps, vehicle) around center by -camYaw, matching the compass. The player triangle then must be drawn unrotated (since the whole world rotates, the player marker points along camera direction... actually the player triangle is drawn rotated by -camYaw, which represents the facing direction). If we rotate the entire world by -camYaw, then the player triangle should be drawn without extra rotation (camera-relative). Hmm, let's think.

In the current code, the triangle is drawn rotated by -camYaw inside translate(cx,cy). This means the triangle's "up" direction is rotated by -camYaw in screen space. The compass directions are placed at angle -camYaw + i*90°.

Simplest consistent approach: rotate whole world layer by -camYaw (rotate about center), keep the player triangle drawn unrotated in that rotated space (so it points to screen-up, which is the camera's forward direction). And compass unchanged. This gives a standard rotating minimap.

Wait, but the compass: N at angle -camYaw from screen up. World north is -z presumably. Rotating the world by -camYaw means the north direction (-z axis in world space) maps to screen direction rotated by -camYaw, which matches compass N placement. Yes — consistent.

So implement: after clearing background, ctx.save(); translate(cx,cy); rotate(-camYaw) if not top mode; then draw grid/zones/items/npcs/wisps/vehicle relative to center with dx,dz offsets. Then player triangle at (0,0) unrotated. Then restore.

In a minimap with north up, screen y = -(world z delta) typically... Let's decide the convention: with the standard math, world +z should map to screen +y (down) when not rotated. For zones: pz = cy + (z.z - p.pos.z)*scale → world +z → screen down. Good. For items: pz = cy + (p.pos.z - it.pos.z)*scale → inverted. Let R(θ) be canvas rotation. Point (0,-1) rotated by θ gives (0*cos - (-1)*sin, 0*sin + (-1)*cos) = (sinθ, -cosθ). Screen position = center + (sinθ, -cosθ)*r. Compass for N: angle = -camYaw = θ → x = cx + sin(θ)*r, y = cy - cos(θ)*r. Match. So rotating the world layer by ctx.rotate(-camYaw) puts world north at the compass N position. Confirmed consistent.

Hmm in top-down mode the camera looks down; camYaw still exists. The compass rotating while map isn't rotated is inconsistent in top mode. parts.text:
Done. Auto-step now works, and I found and fixed two more real bugs it exposed.

## What was wrong

**1. Auto-step was dead code** (`src/world/Collision.js`)
It lived in `if (!delta.y && ...)`, but the player always has gravity, so `delta.y` was non-zero every frame. It never ran once.

Replaced it with a real step-up: on horizontal block, retry the sweep at `y + stepHeight`, accept only if it travels further, isn't blocked, and there's headroom, then settle onto the ledge the same frame. Gated on `box.grounded` (new field passed from `Player.js:416`) so you can't climb walls mid-air.

**2. One-way platforms didn't work at all** — pre-existing
The crossing test was `prevBottom <= maxY && newBottom >= maxY`, but falling means `prevBottom > newBottom` — self-contradictory. Platforms let you fall straight through. Fixed to test the true crossing (`prevBottom >= maxY - EPS && newBottom <= maxY + EPS`) using `box.y`, the pre-move position.

**3. Vertical resolve picked the wrong surface** — pre-existing
The loop overwrote `y` on every match, so the **last** surface in `solids[]` won rather than the highest. Walking from a low ledge toward a slightly taller neighbour sank the player into it. Now picks the highest floor / lowest ceiling.

Bugs 2 and 3 were pre-existing; the auto-step just made them reachable. Bug 2 explains why you'd have hit them constantly once stepping worked.

## Verification

No test framework in the project, so I wrote a throwaway harness in `/tmp/opencode/`:

- 21 unit cases pass: step-up, tall ledges, no stepping airborne, walls, ceilings blocking steps, two ledges in a row, narrow gaps, X and Z axes, `stepHeight=0` disabling it, platform land/pass-through
- 4 end-to-end platform cases pass: stand under → jump through → land on top → walk off
- Fuzz, 122k frames across random ledges, comparing new vs `HEAD`: **16** newly-introduced penetrations vs **19** in the original. The residual is pre-existing (the engine's axis-only push-out can't free a box that spawns inside geometry — 56/200 fuzz spawns land inside a block).
- `npm run build` passes.

Two bugs were in my own first attempt, caught by the fuzzer: the retry sweep started from the already-moved position (double-applied `delta`, tunnelling into ledges), and the vertical pass ran *after* the step and dragged the player back down off the ledge.

Worth a manual pass in-browser on crate/ledge traversal and platform jumping — the numeric harness can't check feel. Nothing is committed.
